spec.scope: Generic (unscoped) stat buffs: ATK ▲5.35%, Critical Damage ▲22.34%, Critical Rate ▲15.51% — no normal-attack/charge/crit-only scoping in the prose.
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock: 'for 45 sec' each — durationSec 45, no round count. Each re-application refreshes all prior steps ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it').
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — 'Activates when using Burst Skill' is her OWN burst cast, NOT fullBurstEnter. Escalating counter = number of her own casts (kind:'escalating', steps 1..N on Nth activation).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter: Survival Instinct advances on EVERY team Full Burst, so with a second Burst III in the comp (controlComp has helm) she reaches SI3 in ~3 rotations even when she casts only half of them — over-credits the buffs AND the burst nuke's stage.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: count(buffApply stat:'atkPct' value:5.35 targetSlug:'vesti') === count of vesti's own burstCast events, strictly less than count of fullBurstStart events in a two-B3 comp; 1st cast emits atkPct only, 2nd cast emits atkPct 5.35 AND critDamagePct 22.34, 3rd+ additionally critRatePct 15.51.
spec.inertness: Zero Survival Instinct buffApply events before her first own burst cast; a Full Burst chained by the other Burst III must add no SI application and advance no stage.

spec.kitLine: two Missile Containers · every 1 sec 18 sec
spec.scope: Function damage (15.56% of final ATK per tick); not a normal attack — no core, no +30% range on riders; crit off by default (opt-in measured-only).
spec.durationSemantics: 18 ticks per container at intervalSec 1 for durationSec 18 — a per-cast DoT instance, NOT a permanent passive (burst CD 40s > 18s, so no overlap between casts).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (deployed by her burst), target 'enemy'. dot encoding: one fresh instance per cast; TWO containers = 2× the tick stream (2 dot effects of 15.56, or one at 31.12).
spec.targetSet: enemy ('the enemy with the lowest remaining HP' — scope-trivial with a single boss).
spec.nearestWrongModel: ONE container modeled instead of two (18 ticks/cast instead of 36 — exactly half the damage), or the line collapsed to a single instant flatDamage 15.56% at cast.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per vesti burst cast, the event log shows 2 tick-damage events per second for 18 s (36 instances) in the burst bucket, per-tick mult 15.56% of final ATK — cast total 560.16% ATK-equivalent, not 280.08% and not a single hit.
spec.inertness: Ticks never carry core; no container ticks exist before her first burst cast; tick count per cast is exactly 36 (no residual instance stacking across casts).

spec.scope: Instant additional damage, % of final ATK; rider rules — no core, noRange; burst-cast damage is FB-EXEMPT (lands before the Full Burst window opens).
spec.durationSemantics: Instantaneous per cast; magnitude is stage-CUMULATIVE ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'): cast 1 = 210.62%, cast 2 = 210.62+247.25 = 457.87%, cast 3+ = 760.06%.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast + escalating(flatDamage steps), sharing the SAME own-cast counter as skill2's Survival Instinct — the stage is the number of her burst uses, not FB count.
spec.targetSet: enemy ('all enemies' — single boss at scope).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Current-stage-only (3rd cast deals 302.19% alone — under-credits ~60%), or full 760.06% from the first cast (over-credits), or the hit taking the +50% Full Burst major.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Summed burst additional-damage instances at her 1st cast = 210.62% ATK, 2nd = 457.87%, 3rd = 760.06%, each event with fbMajorApplied === false and inFullBurst false (pre-FB landing).
spec.inertness: No core bucket, no +30% range on these hits; stage must not advance on the other B3's rotations (mirrors the skill2 trigger assertion).

spec.kitLine: ■ all allies · Full Burst Duration ▼ 5 sec
spec.scope: Rotation-level: shortens the Full Burst WINDOW her cast opens — gates every unit's +50%-window uptime and the whole cycle cadence. This is damage-relevant (window/shot-economy modifier), not a skippable 'utility' line.
spec.durationSemantics: A flat −5 s on that Full Burst's duration (10 s → ~5 s), applied per cast — not a timed buff.
spec.triggerIdentity: Her burst cast, applied to the FB it initiates — fullBurstExtend with seconds: -5 (negative extend).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped entirely as a 'defensive/no-damage drawback' (the classic weapon-state-style skip), or sign-flipped into a +5 s extension.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On a rotation vesti bursts: fullBurstEnd − fullBurstStart ≈ 300 frames (~5 s), vs ~600 frames on a rotation the other Burst III casts; consequently the 180 s FB timeline (count + window lengths) differs measurably from a no-op model.
spec.inertness: Must NOT lengthen any FB; must NOT shorten Full Bursts opened by the other Burst III's cast.

spec.scope: Self, on performing a Full Charge attack; the stat is an AoE RADIUS, not a damage stat — zero extra hits against a single partless boss.
spec.triggerIdentity: Per full-charge shot (shotFired/charge-gated) — moot while unmodeled.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Laundered into a damage stat — projectileExplosionPct 15.01 (Damage Up bucket) or attackDamagePct — because 'Explosion' pattern-matches the RL damage StatKey; that over-credits ~15% for a stat that adds no damage vs one boss.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply with ANY damage-affecting StatKey originates from skill1; emptying skill1's blocks changes vesti's total by exactly 0. The verbatim line appears in unmodeled.skill1.
spec.inertness: Skill1 must move nothing — damage, gauge, rotation all identical with it removed.

loadBearingSet: burst:two Missile Containers dot (36 ticks × 15.56% per cast)
burst:Full Burst Duration ▼ 5 sec (negative fullBurstExtend on her cast)
notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of likelihood: (1) 'Activates when using Burst Skill' keyed to fullBurstEnter — the control fixture pairs her with a second Burst III, so this over-advances Survival Instinct on rotations she never casts; every SI assertion must count HER burstCast events against fullBurstStart events. (2) The 'Full Burst Duration ▼ 5 sec' line silently dropped as a utility/drawback — it is the kit's biggest rotation lever (halves the +50% window on her rotations) and must be asserted via the FB start/end frame delta, not just a buffApply. (3) The container line halved (one container instead of two) or flattened to a single hit — pin the 36-events-per-cast tick count. (4) Escalation semantics: both skill2 and the burst nuke are CUMULATIVE ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it') — assert the 2nd cast deals 457.87%, not 247.25%, and applies BOTH stat buffs; also assert the two escalating tracks share one counter (the 2nd cast's nuke is stage 2 even while cast 1's buffs are still live). (5) Burst nuke FB-exemption: burst-cast instant damage lands pre-FB — fbMajorApplied must be false; a +50%-credited model is the over-credit to catch. Skill1's radius must stay out of projectileExplosionPct. 'Enemy with the lowest remaining HP' targeting is scope-trivial (single boss) and needs no stand-in machinery.
